premise.title: Von Virtanen Manor
lines: Baron von Virtanen has been murdered in his own hall.
His body was found beneath the stopped clock at eleven.
The police have secured the scene. Now a detective
must gather clues, question the household,
and find the murderer before it's too late.

household.name: Chef Ytte
household.line: Prepares every meal at the manor.

household.name: von Virtanen
household.line: Found dead in the hall when the clock stopped.

monologue: ???: You weren't meant to find that page.
???: Burned evidence still talks — and so will you, if I don't stop you.
You: How did you lock the other door as well?!
aftermath: Lady von Virtanen: Help! The dining room is on fire!
Lady von Virtanen: Chef Ytte — drag the detective out of there! Quickly!
wake: Lady von Virtanen: Thank the Lord — you're awake.
Lady von Virtanen: Easy, Detective. You're in the guest wing. I'm so glad you're all right.
Lady von Virtanen: Ytte is resting as well. He inhaled a great deal of smoke dragging you out.
Lady von Virtanen: When you're steady, keep looking. This house is no longer safe for any of us.
diningScare.wakeThought: You: This is getting serious. The murderer wants me dead — they know I'm onto them. I need to look in the baron's rooms.

monologue: ???: Door's locked. Nowhere left to run, Detective.
???: You've been poking around where you shouldn't.

secretPassages.study: The bookshelf grinds aside, revealing a hidden passage.
secretPassages.cellar: The barrels roll aside, revealing a hidden passage.

ballroom.groundskeeperWindow:
Groundskeeper: Beg pardon, Detective! Didn't mean to give you a fright.

Groundskeeper: Just tending to the flower beds under the windows. Roses don't stop growing for a murder.
ballroom.windowLook: Neat flower beds below the window, freshly watered. No one in sight now.
ballroom.chandelierDodged: You: That was far too close. Chandeliers don't just fall on their own... do they?

finale.chaseStart: Chef Ytte is after you! Find a police officer before he catches you!
finale.fistFightTaunt:
Chef Ytte: Running again, Detective? Bok bok bok! Are you a chicken?

Chef Ytte: Tell you what — I'll put the knife away. Bare knuckles. Let's see what you're made of.

You: Nobody calls me a chicken. Put 'em up, Ytte.

fistFightRooms.secret_tunnel: Chef Ytte crumples onto the tunnel floor, out cold. Run — before he comes to!
fistFightRooms.dining: Chef Ytte is knocked out on the floor. Run — now!
